thread.title: Here's how to decide between the red, blue, yellow, white, black, and 'coral' versions of the iPhone XR (AAPL)

author: Dave Smith
title: Here's how to decide between the red, blue, yellow, white, black, and 'coral' versions of the iPhone XR (AAPL)
text: Made in NYC Stock quotes by finanzen.net Here's how to decide between the red, blue, yellow, white, black, and 'coral' versions of the iPhone XR 0m YouTube/MKBHD The new iPhone XS and XS Max are already on sale, but Apple has one more new iPhone waiting in the wings: The iPhone XR is coming on October 26th, and you'll be able to buy it in six available colors. In many ways, the iPhone XR is superior to the new iPhone XS . But which color is best, and how are you supposed to decide before you see the new iPhones in person? Thankfully, YouTuber Marques Brownlee, a.k.a. "MKBHD," spent some time with the new iPhone XR at Apple's big September event and took some beautiful footage of the colorful new phones using his incredible 8K camera rig. It's the next-best thing to seeing these phones in person. Here's a high-definition look at the red, blue, yellow, white, black, and "coral" versions of the new iPhone XR: 1 / First, let's look at the white iPhone XR. Here it is from the front. YouTube/MKBHD And here it is from the back. YouTube/MKBHD 3 / Here it is next to the silver iPhone XS. As you can see, the iPhone XR has a much brighter white color. YouTube/MKBHD 4 / And here's that white iPhone XR from the side. The slightly darker chassis around the sides of the phone provides a nice contrast. YouTube/MKBHD Now, onto the black iPhone XR. Here it is from the front. YouTube/MKBHD And here it is from the back. YouTube/MKBHD Here's a close-up shot of the black iPhone XR. It looks very slick. YouTube/MKBHD The iPhone XR also comes in blue. Here it is from the front. YouTube/MKBHD And here it is from the back. YouTube/MKBHD 10 / Here it is at an angle. You can see the metal edges have a slightly different blue hue, which provides a nice contrast. YouTube/MKBHD Here it is from the side. YouTube/MKBHD And here's a look from the bottom. It's a nice-looking phone. YouTube/MKBHD 13 / There aren't many yellow smartphones out there, but you can buy the iPhone XR in yellow. Here's what the front looks like. YouTube/MKBHD
